25	def main(grid: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    26	    """Assemble the foreground objects by docking equal-colored boundary markers edge-to-edge.
    27	
    28	    Input structure
    29	    The grid has a dominant background color and several 4-connected multicolor foreground
    30	    objects.  One foreground color is the body color; the less frequent foreground colors are
    31	    boundary connector markers, and each marker color appears once as a free end or twice as a
    32	    matched docking pair.
    33	
    34	    Rule
    35	    Crop each foreground object to its bounding box and translate the objects so that the two
    36	    occurrences of every paired connector color touch on their exposed boundary sides.  Preserve
    37	    each object's orientation and colors, then return the tight crop around the assembled
    38	    foreground on the original background color.
    39	
    40	    Key insight
    41	    The colored marker pixels are ports: matching colors specify which objects must touch, and
    42	    the marker's side of its object determines the direction of the translation.
    43	    """

    18	    """
    19	    Replace the outlined object with the outside contour of that outline in the marker color.
    20	
    21	    Input structure:
    22	    - A dominant background surrounds one 8-connected foreground outline.
    23	    - The outline is the unique largest foreground color.
    24	    - One or more smaller interior colors are inside the outline; the marker color
    25	      is the unique smallest non-outline color.
    26	
    27	    Rule:
    28	    - Erase all original foreground pixels to background.
    29	    - Paint every background pixel that is 4-adjacent to the outline with the
    30	      marker color.
    31	    - Keep the grid shape unchanged.
    32	
    33	    Key insight: The colored interior marker supplies the paint color, while the
    34	    largest outline supplies only the contour whose outside edge is traced.
    35	    """

    37	    bg = int(get_bg(g))
    38	
    39	    counts = Counter(map(int, g.flatten()))
    40	    foreground_colors = [color for color in counts if color != bg]
    41	    assert len(foreground_colors) >= 2, "expected an outline color and a marker color"
    42	
    43	    frame_count = max(counts[color] for color in foreground_colors)
    44	    frame_color = _unique_color_with_count(counts, foreground_colors, frame_count)
    45	    assert len(components_mask(g == frame_color, connectivity=8)) == 1, "outline must be 8-connected"

    47	    marker_candidates = [color for color in foreground_colors if color != frame_color]
    48	    marker_count = min(counts[color] for color in marker_candidates)
    49	    marker_color = _unique_color_with_count(counts, marker_candidates, marker_count)

    60	        out[r, c] = marker_color
    61	    return out

    35	    - Sections 3 and 4 are solid color swatches for output foreground and background.

    39	    - Count 4-connected non-black components in section 2.

    16	    - Output grid dimensions are (control_h × tile_h) by (control_w × tile_w).

    30	        cols = colors_present(patch, exclude={bg})
